+                identity = embedded["question_type_id"]
+                canonical = question_types[identity]
+                if embedded != canonical:
+                    normalizations.append(
+                        {
+                            "identity": identity,
+                            "kind": "QuestionType",
+                            "resolution": "canonical_registry_object",
+                        }
+                    )
+        for instance in boundary["procedure_instances"]:
+            identity = instance["procedure_model_ref"]
+            canonical = procedure_models[identity]
+            embedded = instance.get("procedure_model")
+            if embedded != canonical:
+                normalizations.append(
+                    {
+                        "identity": identity,
+                        "kind": "ProcedureModel",
+                        "resolution": "canonical_registry_object",
+                    }
+                )
+    require(
+        canonical_bytes(terminal) == (OUTPUT_ROOT / P405_PROJECTION).read_bytes(),
+        "terminal typed projection must preserve the exact #1766 envelope",
+    )
+    unique_normalizations = {
+        (item["kind"], item["identity"]): item for item in normalizations
+    }
+    return terminal, [
+        unique_normalizations[key] for key in sorted(unique_normalizations)
+    ]
+
+
+def build_ledgers(
+    parts: list[dict[str, Any]],
+    instances: list[dict[str, Any]],
+) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any], dict[str, str]]:
+    by_part_instances: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
+    for instance in instances:
+        by_part_instances[instance["question_part_id"]].append(instance)
+
+    part_entries: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    visual_entries: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    question_parts: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
+    for source in sorted(parts, key=lambda item: item["question_part_id"]):
+        part = deepcopy(source)
+        family = part.pop("_family_identity")
+        shard = part.pop("_shard_identity")
+        question_parts[part["question_id"]].append(part)
+        primary_type = (
+            part.get("question_type", {}).get("question_type_id")
+            if part["status"] == "approved"
+            else None
+        )
+        candidates = sorted(set(part.get("candidate_families", [])))
+        if part.get("candidate_family"):
+            candidates = sorted(set(candidates + [part["candidate_family"]]))
+        related = sorted(
+            by_part_instances.get(part["question_part_id"], []),
+            key=lambda item: item["procedure_instance_id"],
+        )
+        part_entries.append(
+            {
+                "candidate_family_refs": candidates,
+                "family_identity": family,
+                "primary_question_type_ref": primary_type,
+                "procedure_instance_refs": [
+                    item["procedure_instance_id"] for item in related
+                ],
+                "question_id": part["question_id"],
+                "question_part_id": part["question_part_id"],
+                "role": part["role"],
+                "secondary_question_type_refs": [],
+                "shard_identity": shard,
+                "terminal_disposition": part["status"],
+            }
+        )
+        visual = part["visual_review"]
+        visual_entries.append(
+            {
+                "active_bundle_identity": visual["active_bundle_identity"],
+                "bundle_path": visual["bundle_path"],
+                "bundle_sha256": visual["bundle_sha256"],
+                "family_identity": family,
+                "material_visual_facts": visual["material_visual_facts"],
+                "ms_image_refs": visual.get("ms_page_refs", []),
+                "qp_image_refs": visual.get("qp_page_refs", []),
+                "question_id": part["question_id"],
+                "question_part_id": part["question_part_id"],
+                "reviewed_all_ms_pages": visual.get(
+                    "reviewed_all_ms_pages", False
+                ),
+                "reviewed_all_qp_pages": visual.get(
+                    "reviewed_all_qp_pages", False
+                ),
+                "reviewed_shared_or_inherited_context": visual.get(
+                    "reviewed_shared_or_inherited_context", False
+                ),
+                "semantic_evidence_refs": sorted(
+                    set(
+                        part.get("qp_evidence_anchor_refs", [])
+                        + part.get("ms_evidence_anchor_refs", [])
+                    )
+                ),
+                "terminal_disposition": part["status"],
+                "visual_review_rationale": visual["rationale"],
+                "visual_review_status": "authenticated_complete_original_pixel_review",
+            }
+        )
+
+    rank = {"approved": 4, "candidate": 3, "rejected": 2, "abstain": 1}
+    question_statuses: dict[str, str] = {}
+    question_entries: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for question_id, owned_parts in sorted(question_parts.items()):
+        disposition = max(
+            (part["status"] for part in owned_parts), key=rank.__getitem__
+        )
+        question_statuses[question_id] = disposition
+        question_entries.append(
+            {
+                "question_id": question_id,
+                "question_part_count": len(owned_parts),
+                "terminal_disposition": disposition,
+            }
+        )
+    disposition_ledger = {
+        "paper_scope": "9709:paper:4",
+        "question_dispositions": question_entries,
+        "question_part_dispositions": part_entries,
+        "release_version": "p4-terminal-v1",
+        "schema_version": "9709_p4_terminal_disposition_ledger_v1",
+    }
+    visual_ledger = {
+        "authority_posture": "authenticated_complete_original_pixel_review",
+        "paper_scope": "9709:paper:4",
+        "release_version": "p4-terminal-v1",
+        "schema_version": "9709_p4_terminal_visual_review_ledger_v1",
+        "visual_reviews": visual_entries,
+    }
+    return disposition_ledger, visual_ledger, question_statuses
+
+
+def validate_composition(
+    terminal_projection: dict[str, Any],
+    parts: list[dict[str, Any]],
+    instances: list[dict[str, Any]],
+    steps: list[dict[str, Any]],
+    question_types: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+    procedure_models: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+    evidence_hashes: dict[str, set[str]],
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    part_ids = [item["question_part_id"] for item in parts]
+    instance_ids = [item["procedure_instance_id"] for item in instances]
+    step_ids = [item["procedure_step_instance_id"] for item in steps]
+    require(len(part_ids) == len(set(part_ids)), "duplicate QuestionPart identity")
+    require(
+        len(instance_ids) == len(set(instance_ids)),
+        "duplicate ProcedureInstance identity",
+    )
+    require(
+        len(step_ids) == len(set(step_ids)),
+        "duplicate ProcedureStepInstance identity",
+    )
+    part_set = set(part_ids)
+    instance_set = set(instance_ids)
+    require(
+        all(item["question_part_id"] in part_set for item in instances),
+        "dangling ProcedureInstance to QuestionPart reference",
+    )
+    require(
+        all(item["procedure_instance_id"] in instance_set for item in steps),
+        "dangling ProcedureStepInstance reference",
+    )
+    require(
+        all(
+            item["procedure_model_ref"] in procedure_models
+            for item in instances
+        ),
+        "stale ProcedureModel reference",
+    )
+    require(
+        all(
+            not item.get("question_type")
+            or item["question_type"]["question_type_id"] in question_types
+            for item in parts
+        ),
+        "stale QuestionType reference",
+    )
+    require(
+        all(
+            item["question_id"] in evidence_hashes
+            and item["question_id"].removeprefix("qrow_") in ref["path"]
+            for item in parts
+            for key in ("qp_page_refs", "ms_page_refs")
+            for ref in item["visual_review"].get(key, [])
+        ),
+        "stale or cross-question image reference",
+    )
+    by_signature: dict[tuple[str, str, str, str, str], list[str]] = defaultdict(
+        list
+    )
+    for item in instances:
+        signature = (
+            item["question_part_id"],
+            item["procedure_model_ref"],
+            item["branch_key"],
+            item["role"],
+            item["status"],
+        )
+        by_signature[signature].append(item["procedure_instance_id"])
+    duplicate_supporting_candidates = sum(
+        len(values) - 1
+        for signature, values in by_signature.items()
+        if signature[3:] == ("supporting", "candidate") and len(values) > 1
+    )
+    require(
+        duplicate_supporting_candidates == 0,
+        "duplicate supporting ProcedureInstance candidate",
+    )
+    approved_instances = [
+        item for item in instances if item["status"] == "approved"
+    ]
+    candidate_instances = [
+        item for item in instances if item["status"] == "candidate"
+    ]
+    approved_models = {
+        item["procedure_model_ref"] for item in approved_instances
+    }
+    candidate_models = {
+        item["procedure_model_ref"] for item in candidate_instances
+    }
+    candidate_only_models = sorted(candidate_models - approved_models)
+    require(
+        candidate_only_models == ["9709.p4.pm.resolve_contact_force_system"],
+        "candidate-only singleton ProcedureModel inventory drift",
+    )
+    forbidden_tokens = {
+        "arithmetic",
+        "rearrangement",
+        "substitution",
+        "diagram_transcription",
+    }
+    require(
+        not any(
+            token in model
+            for model in procedure_models
+            for token in forbidden_tokens
+        ),
+        "incidental operation promoted to ProcedureModel",
+    )
+    projected_candidate_ids = {
+        item["procedure_instance_id"]
+        for item in terminal_projection["status_boundaries"]["candidate"][
+            "procedure_instances"
+        ]
+    }
+    require(
+        projected_candidate_ids == {item["procedure_instance_id"] for item in candidate_instances},
+        "candidate status boundary drift",
+    )
+    require(
+        projected_candidate_ids.isdisjoint(
+            {
+                item["procedure_instance_id"]
+                for item in terminal_projection["status_boundaries"]["approved"][
+                    "procedure_instances"
+                ]
+            }
+        ),
+        "candidate exposed as approved",
+    )
+    alternative_keys = {
+        (item["question_part_id"], item["branch_key"])
+        for item in instances
+        if "alternative" in item["branch_key"]
+    }
+    return {
+        "alternative_branch_count": len(alternative_keys),
+        "approved_procedure_instance_count": len(approved_instances),
+        "approved_procedure_model_count": len(approved_models),
+        "approved_procedure_reuse_ratio": round(
+            len(approved_instances) / len(approved_models), 6
+        ),
+        "candidate_only_procedure_model_count": len(candidate_only_models),
+        "candidate_only_procedure_model_refs": candidate_only_models,
+        "candidate_procedure_instance_count": len(candidate_instances),
+        "duplicate_supporting_candidate_merge_count": 0,
+        "procedure_instance_count": len(instances),
+        "procedure_model_count": len(procedure_models),
+        "procedure_reuse_ratio_all_statuses": round(
+            len(instances) / len(procedure_models), 6
+        ),
+        "procedure_step_instance_count": len(steps),
+        "supporting_procedure_instance_count": sum(
+            item["role"] == "supporting" for item in instances
+        ),
+    }
+
+
